filings.title: Company filings
filings.description: Explore SEC filings and read the original documents.
filings.emptyDescription: Try another form type or return to an earlier page.
filings.documentLabel: View {{form}} filed {{date}} (opens in a new tab)
filings.unknownDescription: No company found for {{ticker}}. Check the ticker and try again.
filings.errorDescription: Please try again. The filings service may be temporarily unavailable.

summary.title: Company summary
summary.description: Compare filing activity over the last 12 months.
summary.placeholder: Add tickers, e.g. AAPL, SPOT, JPM
summary.tickerError: Compare up to 25 unique tickers. Remove a ticker before adding more.
summary.emptyInput: Enter at least one ticker to add.
summary.columnHelp: Show up to five exact form types. Other contains all remaining forms, including amendments.
summary.dateHelp: Counts use filing dates in the period above (UTC). Latest 10-K searches all available history; amendments are separate forms.
summary.startDescription: Add company tickers to compare their filing counts, form types, and latest 10-K dates.
summary.loading: Loading company histories… Larger selections may take longer.
summary.unknownDescription: One or more tickers could not be found. Remove incorrect tickers and add their replacements. No partial summary is available.
summary.errorDescription: The complete selection could not be loaded. Try again; the filings service may be temporarily unavailable.
